name: batch-file-renamer
description: Rename a whole folder of files by rules — find/replace or regex, name templates with numbering, dates and folder names, case and space clean-up, lower-case extensions and per-file manual names. See old → new for every file and every clash before anything changes, rename safely (swaps and case-only changes work), keep a log, and undo the last rename. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Rename a whole folder of files by rules — find/replace or regex, name templates with numbering, dates and folder names, case and space clean-up, lower-case extensions and per-file manual names. See old → new for every file and every clash before anything changes, rename safely (swaps and case-only changes work), keep a log, and undo the last rename. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 按规则批量重命名整个文件夹：查找替换或正则、带序号/日期/文件夹名的命名模板、大小写和空格整理、扩展名统一小写，也可逐个手动指定新名。改名前就能看到每个文件的“原名 → 新名”和所有冲突，安全执行（互换名字、只改大小写也没问题），留下改名记录，还能撤销上一次改名。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
